name: XP-08
description: XP-08: an XP-80 style PCM synthesizer that plays Roland SR-JV80 expansion boards from their dumps (put them in roms/). Four board slots, the boards' own JV-1080 patches, four tones per patch with pitch, filter and amp envelopes, two LFOs, matrix control, EFX, chorus and reverb.
author: Stephane Schmitz
